title.narrative: Support NRC Consortium under the Rohingya Response and National Resilience Programme

description.narrative:
1. Improved access to inclusive specialized protection services for persons with heightened protection risk through individual case management, protection assistance, community-based protection, counselling and legal assistance.
2. Increased access to safe, inclusive and protective quality education for out-of-school adolescents in Rohingya refugee camps
3. Improved access to and inclusiveness of health services within the Rohingya and host communities by direct provision of services, and strengthening of community-based mechanisms, including disability-specialized services.
4. Refugee needs and demands inform humanitarian policy and practice, and a rights-based approach is adopted across the response.
5. Rohingya Refugess and Host Community People including children, adolescents, youth, older people and people with disabilities male and female.
Rohingya Refugess and Host Community People including children, adolescents, youth, older people and people with disabilities male and female.

The project will implement a comprehensive set of activities through a coordinated and integrated approach. This will involve strengthening protection mechanisms, improving responses of the human rights situation through protection case management, access to information about rights and entitlements, and provision of legal assistance, as well as supporting housing, land, and property (HLP) rights. Additionally, the project will ensure access to essential services such as education, healthcare, and tailored assistance to persons with disabilities (PWDs) in the camps and host communities. Moreover, the project will regularly conduct protection monitoring in camps and host communities and produce a protection monitoring bulletin on a quarterly basis. The protection monitoring helps consortium members and contributes to protection sector in identifying key protection risks and trends through ongoing data collection to inform evidence-based advocacy and evidence-informed action for quality project outcomes.
